description: Manages protections that stop other editors from changing cells. action=add protects a grid range (or a named range via named_range_id; a range with only sheet_id protects the whole sheet): warning_only=true merely warns before edits, otherwise only the listed editor_users/editor_groups (emails) plus the owner may edit — note the calling user is NOT added automatically. Returns the new protectedRangeId in the replies. action=update changes description/warning_only/editors of an existing protection (protected_range_id required; provided fields replace the old values). action=delete removes the protection — the cells and data stay, but anyone with edit access can change them again. Find existing protectedRangeIds via get_spreadsheet.

action.description: What to do with the protections.

description.description: Label shown in the Sheets UI protections list.

editor_groups.description: Emails of Google Groups allowed to edit.

editor_users.description: Emails of users allowed to edit the protected cells.

named_range_id.description: add: protect a named range instead of a grid range.

protected_range_id.description: update/delete: the protection's id from get_spreadsheet or the add reply.

end_column_index.description: End column, exclusive (omit = to the last column).

end_row_index.description: End row, exclusive (omit = to the last row).

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId from get_spreadsheet (not the title).

start_row_index.description: First row, 0-based inclusive (omit = from the top).

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.

warning_only.description: true = anyone can still edit after a warning; false = only the listed editors.

name: manage_protected_ranges
title: Manage protected ranges
